class.name: GoetheDialogue
class.brief_description: Parsed Goethe branching dialogue resource loaded from GSF-A or simple YAML.
class.description: [GoetheDialogue] holds an immutable parsed Goethe dialogue tree loaded via the pre-built Goethe native runtime ([code]goethe.dll[/code] / [code]libgoethe[/code]). Load once and pass to one or more [GoetheDialogueRunner] instances.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the dialogue identifier defined in YAML.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the most recent load or parse error message, or an empty string if none occurred.

method.name: get_metadata
method.description: Returns the key-value metadata dictionary attached to the dialogue.

method.name: get_node_count
method.description: Returns the number of nodes in the loaded dialogue.

method.name: get_node_ids
method.description: Returns all node IDs in declaration order.

method.name: get_node_info
method.description: Returns static structural metadata for [param node_id] (speaker, tags, line keys, choices, auto-advance).

method.name: get_source_path
method.description: Returns the file path passed to [method load_from_file], or an empty string when loaded from raw YAML.

method.name: get_speakers
method.description: Returns the unique speaker entity IDs referenced across all nodes.

method.name: get_start_node
method.description: Returns the entry node ID ([code]startNode[/code] or the first node).

method.name: has_node
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the dialogue contains a node with ID [param node_id].

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a valid dialogue tree is loaded.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Loads and parses a Goethe YAML dialogue file from [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], or an absolute path.

method.name: load_from_yaml
method.description: Parses a Goethe dialogue directly from an in-memory YAML string.

method.name: to_yaml
method.description: Serializes the loaded dialogue back to canonical YAML text.

method.name: validate
method.description: Validates structural integrity (duplicate IDs, missing [code]startNode[/code], dangling choice targets) and returns any problem descriptions.
